description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Raydar is recruiting on behalf of an unnamed client, a fast-growing financial services company. The Junior Software Engineer will build and improve customer-facing web pages and marketing site features, collaborate with marketing on conversion experiments, and gradually take on broader full-stack ownership.
Junior Software Engineer building React website pages, extending CMS content models, testing conversion paths, and improving performance

Responsibilities:
• Build and launch responsive pages and visual updates for a company website using React-based tooling and utility-first styling
• Maintain and extend the content management data model so marketing can publish changes with less engineering involvement
• Partner with marketing on site experiments, split tests and improvements to the conversion path
• Improve loading speed and core page performance across mobile and desktop devices
• Expand gradually into full-stack work and ownership of larger parts of the site

Requirements:
• Prior hands-on experience taking front-end screens or product features from development to release in a public-facing web product
• Working knowledge of modern React and core web technologies such as HTML, CSS and JavaScript or TypeScript
• Ability to build responsive, precise layouts that work well across many screen sizes, with mobile traffic being the majority
• High ownership and curiosity, with comfort driving problems to completion independently
• Interest in growing from frontend work into full-stack engineering rather than a design-focused career

Preferred:
• Evidence of self-directed initiative through independent projects or public code work
• Experience at a fintech, health technology or e-commerce company
• Degree from a strong computer science or technical program
• Experience with a utility-first CSS framework, a headless content management system or a modern hosting platform
